title: Stress granules as RNA triage hubs suppress extracellular vesicle secretion under oxidative stress in cancer.
authors: Dong, Yue; Yoshida, Takeshi; Maeda, Mitsuyo; Adachi, Haruki; Eguchi, Asami; Mishiro-Sato, Emi; Okuzaki, Daisuke; Kataoka, Yosky; Yoshida, Takuya; Oneyama, Chitose
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氧化应激下应激颗粒通过FOXO3a-ROS通路抑制CD63+细胞外囊泡分泌，涉及转录因子FOXO3a但核心是RNA代谢与囊泡分泌，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cancer cells confronting oxidative stress must coordinate their extracellular vesicle (EV) secretion to balance intercellular signaling with the intracellular programs required for survival, yet how these decisions are integrated remains poorly understood. Here, we identify a stress-adaptive mechanism in which stress granules (SGs) selectively suppress CD63(+) EV release. Using a bioluminescent EV-reporter screen, we found that the clinical compound YM155 selectively inhibits CD63(+) EV secretion across diverse tumor cells. Mechanistically, YM155 rapidly inactivates the antioxidant transcription factor FOXO3a, diminishing expression of key detoxifying enzymes and leading to delayed but sustained accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS). Elevated ROS drives SG formation, and these SGs function not as passive storage sites but as RNA triage hubs that exclude and destabilize a subset of transcripts. Among them, Rab27A mRNA-encoding a GTPase essential for multivesicular-body docking to the plasma membrane-is selectively excluded and degraded, resulting in loss of Rab27A protein and suppression of CD63(+) EV secretion. Forced Rab27A expression restores EV release but paradoxically reduces proliferation under oxidative stress, indicating that EV suppression is prosurvival. The same FOXO3a-ROS-SG-Rab27A axis operates during physiological glucose deprivation and is evident in vivo, where SGs form in xenograft tumors and circulating CD63(+) EVs decline. Pancancer transcriptomic analyses further show that Rab27A expression correlates with FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant programs, underscoring clinical relevance. These findings reveal that SGs actively reprogram RNA fate to tune vesicle output, establishing a redox-responsive mechanism by which cancer cells transiently suppress EV secretion to enhance survival.
abstract_zh: 面对氧化应激的癌细胞必须协调其细胞外囊泡（extracellular vesicle, EV）分泌，以平衡细胞间信号传导与生存所需的细胞内程序，然而这些决策如何整合仍知之甚少。在此，我们鉴定出一种应激适应机制，其中应激颗粒（stress granules, SGs）选择性抑制CD63(+) EV释放。利用生物发光EV报告基因筛选，我们发现临床化合物YM155在多种肿瘤细胞中选择性抑制CD63(+) EV分泌。机制上，YM155迅速失活抗氧化转录因子FOXO3a，降低关键解毒酶的表达，导致活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）延迟但持续积累。升高的ROS驱动SG形成，这些SG并非作为被动储存位点，而是作为RNA分诊枢纽，排除并 destabilize 一部分转录本。其中，编码GTPase（对多泡体与质膜对接至关重要）的Rab27A mRNA被选择性排除并降解，导致Rab27A蛋白缺失及CD63(+) EV分泌抑制。强制表达Rab27A可恢复EV释放，但在氧化应激下反而降低增殖，表明EV抑制是促生存的。相同的FOXO3a-ROS-SG-Rab27A轴在生理性葡萄糖剥夺期间运作，并在体内明显可见，其中SG在异种移植肿瘤中形成，循环CD63(+) EVs下降。泛癌转录组分析进一步显示，Rab27A表达与FOXO3a依赖性抗氧化程序相关，强调临床相关性。这些发现揭示SG主动重编程RNA命运以调节囊泡输出，建立一种氧化还原响应机制，癌细胞通过该机制瞬时抑制EV分泌以增强生存。
